subject: Tesla 2026 Roadster / Rocket visual and suction reference review
scope: Official product-page text and twelve official static images were inspected in this review. This is reference research, not Tesla CAD or vehicle calibration.

officialPage.access: Viewed successfully in browser; image URLs read from actual img/source DOM attributes. Direct Python page request returned HTTP 403, so no raw-page scrape was used.
officialPage.configuration: Performance has active aero and suction; Thrust adds rear cold-gas propulsion; Rocket has perimeter cold-gas thrusters for forward/upward acceleration and lateral rotation. The page identifies Rocket as single-seat.
officialPage.suctionConfirmation: Tesla describes powered fans removing air beneath the vehicle, working with a ground-sealing system to generate downforce even at zero vehicle speed, sufficient for a stationary inverted demonstration.
officialPage.controlConfirmation: Tesla says cold-gas thrusters use electric actuators for rapid adjustments. Exact valve response, controller gains, nozzle thrust maps and Tesla control code are not supplied by this page.
officialPage.appearanceConfirmation: Tesla describes hidden headlights, a full-width taillight, flush aero, thin wheel spokes, Ano White body finish and copper/gold tinted glazing.

assets.inspection: Every downloaded image was opened with view_image. Native dimensions and SHA-256 hashes are in the manifest.
assets.credit: Images © Tesla. Retained as subject reference for this independent, unaffiliated simulation; no CAD, brand licence, production approval or open-asset licence is claimed.

videoReview.currentSession: The Kickflip official watch page was opened. Tesla verified channel, video title and description were visible, but the player demanded sign-in to confirm the viewer is not a bot. Event web extraction yielded no frames; two other official watch URLs were throttled. No video was downloaded, no authentication challenge was bypassed and no unseen video frames were inferred.
videoReview.implementationConstraint: Use the inspected official Gravity still as the direct plume appearance reference. Treat valve timing and control-triggered pulses as model parameters, not video-measured or Tesla-certified timings.

confirmed: Fan suction beneath the car and a ground-sealing system are explicitly described by Tesla
Rear fan modules, black lower shroud and downward thruster outlets are visually documented
A stationary inverted demonstration needs a pressure difference acting across a useful area; visual body closure alone is not the physical downforce calculation
notFoundInInspectedOfficialSources: Full underfloor photograph with the sealing perimeter exposed
Sectional drawing of low-pressure plenum, ducts or seal geometry
Tesla CAD or dimensioned blueprint for the 2026 body
Skirt deployment travel, compliance, permitted leakage or contact force
Fan pressure-flow-power curves and calibrated pressure-distribution data
underbodyAndSeal.oldManualWarning: Tesla service search results for Roadster 1.5 / 2.x describe the first-generation Roadster, despite some pages having recent update dates. Their motor cooling fans, seals and suspension dimensions must not be imported as 2026 Rocket suction hardware.
recommendedReconstruction: Provide a continuous dark undertray and an enclosed low-pressure plenum bounded by a perimeter sealing lip
Keep wheel housings separated from the plenum rather than making the entire open wheel volume part of a magical suction cavity
Connect the visible rear fan/shroud region to the modeled low-pressure volume; show vents and keep thruster outlets separate
Allow the visual skirt to approach the surface within its documented simulation travel; do not extend it arbitrarily across flight altitude
Label the plenum, perimeter lip and hidden ducts as engineering reconstruction, not Tesla-released CAD
underbodyAndSeal.physicalExplanation: A practical fan car is not perfectly hermetic. The fan removes air fast enough to maintain pressure below ambient despite seal leakage. Suction is approximately the pressure difference integrated over the sealed effective area; seal gap and fan capability govern how much pressure difference survives. No public numerical Tesla seal map was obtained.

reconstructionPriorities: Match silhouette, greenhouse, front fascia, correct panel separation and wheel/arch proportions before adding polygon count
Use smooth controlled normals on subtly curved painted surfaces with crisp panel boundaries; avoid a uniformly faceted toy-like body
Give fender openings and inner wheel liners a geometric clearance envelope covering compression, droop, steering and tire width
Use the four rear nozzles and four rear fan modules as documented visual anchors
Build dense narrow white jet cores and broader turbulent mist, with illuminated ground wash instead of additive fire or tiny glitter points
Keep hidden engineering choices visibly documented as reconstruction assumptions
